criteria.name: Functionality
criteria.description: Calculator performs all required operations correctly

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All operations work correctly: add, subtract, multiply, divide with error handling

levels.label: Mostly Complete
levels.description: Most operations work, minor issues with edge cases

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some operations work, missing error handling

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Few or no operations work correctly

criteria.name: Object-Oriented Design
criteria.description: Proper use of classes and separation of concerns

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Multiple files, separate Calculator class, clean interface, proper encapsulation

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Uses classes but could be better organized

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: No OOP principles, all code in main

criteria.name: Error Handling
criteria.description: Handles invalid input and division by zero

levels.label: Comprehensive
levels.description: Handles all error cases gracefully with meaningful messages

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Handles some errors but not all

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Minimal error handling, program crashes on invalid input

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Well-documented, clear naming, proper file organization
